/** Returns the given target map with the result added under its uuid, unless
    * an unchanged result already exists in the lookup map.
    *
    * @param target
    *   The map that should be updated.
    * @param lookup
    *   The map used to check whether the result changed.
    * @param uuid
    *   The uuid of the result.
    * @param result
    *   The result to add if changed.
    * @return
    *   The (possibly) updated target map.
    */
  private def updatedIfChanged(
      target: Map[UUID, ResultEntity],
      lookup: Map[UUID, ResultEntity],
      uuid: UUID,
      result: ResultEntity,
  ): Map[UUID, ResultEntity] =
    lookup.get(uuid) match {
      case Some(oldResult) if isUnchanged(result, oldResult) =>
        target
      case _ =>
        target.updated(uuid, result)
    }
